about.title: Dion Dominic
about.description1: I am a photojournalist and documentary filmmaker dedicated to capturing raw, unfiltered human experiences. For over a decade, I have traveled to the margins of society to document stories that challenge our perspectives and unite our shared humanity.
about.description2: My work has been featured in leading editorial publications globally, focusing on environmental change, cultural preservation, and resilience.

storiesIntro.title: Visual Narratives
storiesIntro.description: Explore a collection of photo essays and visual narratives documenting unique moments and perspectives.

filmsIntro.title: Cinematic Explorations
filmsIntro.description: Award-winning short films that dive deep into the cultural heartbeats of remote communities.

services.title: Services & Expertise
services.service1Desc: High-impact imagery for magazines, news outlets, and digital publications. Focusing on narrative depth and visual storytelling.
services.service2Desc: Full-scale video production for short and feature-length documentaries, capturing cinematic visuals with authentic audio.
services.service3Desc: Bringing a photojournalistic, raw aesthetic to brand campaigns and commercial projects that demand authenticity.

contact.title: Let's Tell a Story
contact.description: Available for assignments worldwide. For print sales, licensing, or commissions, please get in touch.
contact.profile: Dion Dominic is a member of the Association of Photojournalists. Over the last decade, his lens has captured stories of environmental resilience and human perseverance across five continents.
